newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE sets record daily volume of trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE sets record daily volume of trade.

text.p: South Africa's Johannesburg Stock Exchange said that it had set a new record volume of trade on Thursday.
Shares worth 1.111 billion rand changed hands in a hectic trading session as positive sentiment swept through the market. The previous record was 1.068 billion on December 12, 1996.
The market is being buoyed by a surging rand, a bullish bond market and a healthy outlook for interest rates.
